Camera: head-and-shoulders bust portrait for a game interface, level three-quarter view, the character turned slightly to the right (south-east) and looking at the viewer, head and upper chest filling most of the square, centred on a transparent background. The bust ends cleanly at the chest; nothing else is in the image. Faction: a cheerful sweet shop of many different sweets, bright, glossy and silly. Its fixed colours: glossy milk and dark chocolate brown; golden caramel and toffee; pale biscuit wafer; matte marshmallow white and cream; clear jewel-coloured gummy jelly and hard candy in apple green, lemon yellow and amber orange; white peppermint with mint green stripes; a little liquorice black; cotton-candy pink frosting, colour #ffb8d8, only as a small trim; one hard pure white highlight on every glossy surface. Class: one chunky cute character portrait with a huge round head and big friendly eyes, the same chunky body language as the map piece, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone; it must read at a glance at 48 pixels. Subject: a close-up portrait of a chunky cute living wrapped toffee soldier: one big fat rounded cube of glossy golden caramel toffee, colour #e0a040, shaded #b06a1c, with one hard white highlight, filling most of the square, with two twisted fan-shaped wrapper ends of pale lemon yellow and white paper sticking out wide at its left and right like big ears, and a small dark chocolate knob on its top; the face is on the cube itself, two big round black dot eyes under short determined brows, two small pink cheeks and a small smile; beside it the top of a round mint green and white swirl lollipop. A close-up seen from the front: the square toffee cube with its face fills the middle of the square, and both twisted wrapper ends are visible, one on its left and one on its right; small black dot eyes with no whites; no legs and no feet.
